CreateAutofeExperiment.description_zh: 创建一个自动特征工程实验

DeleteHpoExperiment.description_en: Deletes an HPO experiment. After deletion, the experiment and its trial data are no longer returned by Get or List API operations
DeleteHpoExperiment.description_zh: 删除一个HPO实验。删除后，实验和它的trials数据都不会再通过Get/List API返回

GetAutofeExperiment.description_en: Retrieves the details of an AutoFE experiment

GetHpoExperiment.description_en: Retrieves the details of a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment, including the status, configurations, and the status of associated trials
GetHpoExperiment.description_zh: 获取一个HPO实验的信息，包括状态、配置、以及所属trials的状态等数据

GetHpoTrial.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified trial in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment
GetHpoTrial.description_zh: 获取一个HPO实验里一个指定Trial的信息

GetServiceIdentityRole.description_en: Retrieves the service identity role. Returns the role name if the service-linked role exists, or an empty string otherwise
GetServiceIdentityRole.description_zh: GetServiceIdentityRole, return role name if SLR exists, empty otherwise

ListHpoExperimentLogs.description_en: Displays the content of a specified log for an HPO experiment
ListHpoExperimentLogs.description_zh: 显示一个HPO实验指定log的内容

ListHpoExperiments.description_en: Queries HPO experiments that match the specified conditions
ListHpoExperiments.description_zh: 查询符合条件的HPO实验信息

ListHpoTrialCommands.description_en: Retrieves the output of one or more background commands sequentially executed in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) trial according to the configured command set
ListHpoTrialCommands.description_zh: HPO一个trial会按配置里的命令集，顺序运行一个或多个后台命令。这些命令在执行时的输出可以通过这个API返回

ListHpoTrialLogNames.description_en: Retrieves the names of all log files for a specified trial in a specified HPO experiment
ListHpoTrialLogNames.description_zh: 返回指定的HPO实验里指定的trial所拥有的所有的log文件的名称

ListHpoTrialLogs.description_en: Retrieves the paginated content of a specified log for an HPO trial
ListHpoTrialLogs.description_zh: 分页显示一个hpo trial的一个指定日治的内容

ListHpoTrials.description_en: Retrieves the trials of a specified experiment

RestartHpoTrials.description_en: Restarts failed trials in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. For a specified trial, extracts the hyperparameter configuration used by the trial. If no trials using this configuration have succeeded in the experiment, starts a new trial with this configuration
RestartHpoTrials.description_zh: 重启一个HPO实验里失败的trials。对于指定的trial，提取它使用的超参配置。如果该实验所有使用这个配置的trials都没有成功过，那么用这个配置重新启动一个trial

StopHpoExperiment.description_en: Stops a specified AutoML HPO experiment, including the trials belonging to the experiment and the background tasks on which these trials depend
StopHpoExperiment.description_zh: 完全停止一个指定的AutoML HPO实验，包括停止该实验所属的trials，和这些trials所依赖的后台任务

StopHpoTrials.description_en: Stops specific trials in a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment and the backend tasks of the trials
StopHpoTrials.description_zh: 停止一个HPO实验里指定的trials，以及这些trials对应的后台任务

UpdateHpoExperiment.description_en: Updates the configurations of a running hyperparameter optimization (HPO) experiment. After you update the experiment, the experiment continues to run based on the new configurations
UpdateHpoExperiment.description_zh: 更新一个正在运行中的HPO实验的设置。更新成功后，该实验将按照新的设置继续执行
